intro.heading: I build fast, clear, and easy-to-use websites
intro.tagline: No unnecessary stuff, no slow websites, and no making your life harder.
intro.servicesOverview: Depending on what you need, I can build anything from a simple website to a more interactive one with forms, search features, or advanced functionality.
intro.hostingNote: I don't normally handle domains or hosting, but if you don't want the hassle, I can take care of it and include it in the quote.

pricing.description: Every project is different, so pricing is discussed with no obligation.

about.title: Who's behind this
about.intro: My name is Héctor Jarque. I didn't come from an agency or a miracle bootcamp. I learned by building things, breaking them, and fixing them.
about.location: I live in Valencia. I work remotely without any problem, and if you're nearby, we can grab a coffee.
about.learning: I started without understanding anything, and little by little I trained myself until I was able to create the websites and projects I build today.
about.honesty: I won't throw jargon at you to impress you. If something can't be done, I'll tell you.
